recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-20203 source edit is needed unless the work group later chooses a broader editorial cleanup of operation response prose.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking to resolve inconsistent Operations page wording that described operation outputs as both one-or-more and zero-or-more parameters.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 7aa4b98258, which changed source/operations.html to separate zero-or-more input parameters from one-or-more output parameters and documented the special return output case.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists operations.html in the current build. Later Published/Persuasive issues FHIR-24869 and FHIR-28292 refined the same paragraph by adding zero-output response-body omission and changing the qualifying single Resource return from MAY to SHALL/no-wrapping; both related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active source says operations take zero-or-more inputs, optionally return a Parameters resource with one-or-more outputs, may omit the body when there are zero outputs, and SHALL return the qualifying single Resource output without wrapping Parameters.

related_jiras.note: Clarified operation success/error status handling and that operations with zero output parameters may return an empty response body; already represented on the combined branch.
Refined the single Resource return shortcut from MAY to SHALL/no-wrapping for a max-cardinality-1 output named return; already represented on the combined branch.
